QF.id: IV Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_1

question.text: Schedule II of the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 1992 prescribes:

answer.text: Code of conduct for stock brokers

explanation.text: The Logic: Schedule II of the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 1992 sets out the code of conduct for securities brokers. It covers integrity, due skill and care, prevention of manipulation and malpractices, and statutory compliance. The Trap: Margin requirements are issued by SEBI through separate circulars, not Schedule II. Bond listing requirements sit under the LODR regulations, and capital adequacy norms for exchanges are a different framework altogether.
